tools.name: search_inventory
tools.description: Search live dealer-direct New, Used, and Certified Pre-Owned car inventory across Miami and South Florida dealerships. Supports natural free-text query, condition ('new', 'used', 'certified'), make, model, trim, year_min/year_max, price_max, mileage_max, zip + radius_miles (geo search), fuel_type, d

tools.name: get_vehicle
tools.description: Retrieve the complete canonical record for a single vehicle by its vehicle_id or 17-character VIN. Returns full specifications, pricing breakdown & fee disclosures, price history, all high-res photo URLs, dealer contact info, and source_url back to the dealer's VDP.

tools.name: list_dealers
tools.description: List all indexed dealerships on the platform across 9 US regions and states, their physical locations, website platforms, last crawl timestamps, live available New and Used inventory counts, and price ranges.

tools.name: submit_lead
tools.description: Submit a buyer inquiry/lead directly to a participating dealership for a specific vehicle or general inventory inquiry. Requires explicit buyer consent (consent=true) and at least one contact method (buyer_email or buyer_phone). Returns a lead_id and delivery status.

tools.name: get_lead_status
tools.description: Check the delivery state, webhook/email attempts, duplicate flag, and billing ledger status of a submitted lead. Requires dealer_api_key.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_lead_status" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Check the delivery state, webhook/email attempts, duplicate flag, and billing ledger status of a submitted lead. Requires dealer_api_key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_vehicle, get_lead_status · Private data: get_vehicle, submit_lead · Public sink: submit_lead, get_lead_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_vehicle, get_lead_status · Private data: get_vehicle, submit_lead · Public sink: submit_lead, get_lead_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

labels.name: accept_deal_and_reveal
labels.description: Once the buyer approves a dealership's verified Out-The-Door quote, unlock the buyer's real name, email/phone, and preferred appointment window to the dealership. Requires explicit buyer permission (consent=true).

labels.name: burn_proxy_thread
labels.description: One-click privacy kill-switch: permanently closes a shielded deal thread and revokes its proxy relay email address so any subsequent BDC drip emails or follow-ups from that dealership are silently dropped.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_inventory" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search live dealer-direct New, Used, and Certified Pre-Owned car inventory across Miami and South Florida dealerships. Supports natural free-text query, condition ('new', 'used', 'certified'), make, model, trim, year_min/year_max, price_max, mileage_max, zip + radius_miles (geo search), fuel_type, d" → after: "Search live New, Used, Certified Pre-Owned, and Classic/Collector car inventory across participating US franchise dealerships, 20+ specialist classic & collector showrooms (Streetside Classics, Classic Auto Mall, GR Auto Gallery, RK Motors, Vanguard Motor Sales, Volo Auto Museum, Worldwide Vintage A"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
